# The new expense claims process

## Purpose of this report

This report gives the results of the expense claims process the sales team trialed, and proposes a company-wide rollout in October.

## The problem with the current process

Finance receives an average of 420 paper claims a month and spends about six minutes matching each one against its receipt. Eighteen percent of claims are sent back for missing fields or receipts.

## Trial results

In June and July, 25 members of the sales team used a new expense system. They photograph a receipt on a phone, and the amount and date are read from the photo. Review time fell to about two minutes per claim, and the return rate fell from 18% to 7%. We think most of the drop comes from no longer writing dates and amounts by hand. Both claimants and finance spend less time on each claim.

## Cost

The system costs 30,000 yen a month. Against finance's time, a company-wide rollout would pay for itself in the first month. Going paperless also supports our commitment to sustainability.

## Open issue and timeline

Receipt images must be kept for seven years, like paper receipts, so we need to agree with General Affairs on where they are stored and who owns them. We will consult General Affairs in August, settle the storage rules at the September managers' meeting, and roll out to the whole company in October. We ask for everyone's cooperation with the switch.
